content: Q: How do I create an account? A: You can sign up in the CareBridge app with your email and password, or with Google. New accounts created this way are patient accounts.
Q: Can I sign in with Google? A: Yes, you can sign in with your Google account. Use the Sign in with Google button on the login page.
Q: I cannot sign in to my account. What should I do? A: Please contact reception at +880 1711-000000. Reception is open Saturday to Thursday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
Q: How do I update my profile details? A: Open My Profile in the app. There you can update details such as your phone, address, allergies, and emergency contact.

Q: Who can see my medical records? A: Patients see only their own appointments, prescriptions, and bills. Doctors see the records of their own patients, and reception staff can see all records to run the clinic.
Q: Can my family share one account? A: No, each person needs their own account. Family members cannot share one account.
Q: How are doctor and receptionist roles assigned? A: New sign-ups are patient accounts. Doctor and receptionist roles are assigned by reception.
Q: How do I delete my account? A: Please contact reception to delete your account. The reception phone is +880 1711-000000.
Q: How do I book an appointment? A: Open Book Appointment in the app. Choose a doctor, a date, and a time slot, then enter the reason for the visit. The booking starts with status requested.
Q: What information do I need to book an appointment? A: You need the doctor, the date, the time slot, and a short reason for the visit.
Q: How do I choose the right doctor? A: The doctor list shows each doctor's specialization, fee, and working days. The assistant can suggest a specialization, but it is not medical advice.
Q: How do I choose a time slot? A: Only the doctor's working days and listed slots can be booked. A slot that is already booked cannot be chosen.
Q: What does requested status mean? A: Requested means reception has not confirmed the booking yet. Reception confirms it within the same working day.
Q: How will I know my appointment is confirmed? A: The status changes to confirmed in My Appointments. You also receive a reminder within the 24 hours before the visit.
Q: How long does confirmation take? A: Reception confirms requested bookings within the same working day. Working days are Saturday to Thursday.
Q: The slot I want is already booked. What can I do? A: A booked slot cannot be chosen. You can join the waitlist for that doctor and day.
Q: Can I book an appointment for someone else? A: No, each patient books from their own account. Family members need their own accounts.
Q: Do you accept walk-in patients? A: Walk-ins are seen only if a slot is free. Booking in the app is preferred.
Q: What should I bring to my first visit? A: Please bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports.
Q: What happens if I arrive late? A: Arriving more than 15 minutes late may require rescheduling.
Q: How do I cancel an appointment? A: Open My Appointments and cancel the appointment. You can cancel while the status is requested or confirmed.
Q: Which appointments can I cancel? A: Only requested or confirmed appointments can be cancelled. Completed appointments cannot be cancelled.
Q: Is there a cancellation fee? A: No, there is no cancellation fee.
Q: How do I reschedule an appointment? A: Open My Appointments and choose reschedule. Then pick a new future date on the doctor's working day and slot.

Q: What are the rules for rescheduling? A: Only requested or confirmed appointments can be rescheduled. The new date must be in the future, and the new slot must be one of the doctor's slots on a working day.
Q: Can I change a completed appointment? A: No, completed appointments cannot be cancelled or rescheduled. Please book a new follow-up appointment instead.
Q: What counts as a no-show? A: A confirmed appointment not completed 1 hour after its start time is flagged as a possible no-show.
Q: What happens after I miss an appointment? A: Reception reviews the possible no-show and may contact you to rebook.
Q: What is the waitlist? A: The waitlist lets you wait for a full day or slot with a doctor. When a slot is freed, the next patient on the waitlist gets an offer.
Q: How do I join the waitlist? A: Join the waitlist when the slot or day you want is full. You can have one open waitlist entry per doctor and day.
Q: How will I know I got a waitlist offer? A: You get a notification under the bell icon. The offer also appears in My Appointments.

Q: How long do I have to accept a waitlist offer? A: You have 120 minutes to accept the offer. Accept it in My Appointments. If you do not accept it in time, the offer expires and the slot then passes to the next patient on the waitlist.
Q: My waitlist offer expired. What now? A: An offer not accepted within 120 minutes expires, and the slot passes to the next patient on the waitlist. You can join the waitlist again.
Q: How do I leave the waitlist? A: You can leave the waitlist at any time from My Appointments.
Q: Will I get a reminder before my appointment? A: Yes, a reminder is sent within the 24 hours before a confirmed appointment. Reminders appear under the bell icon in the app.
Q: Where do I see my notifications? A: Notifications appear under the bell icon in the app.
Q: I did not get a reminder. Why? A: Reminders are sent only for confirmed appointments. Please check that your booking status is confirmed.
Q: Do you send SMS reminders? A: No, the clinic does not send SMS reminders. Reminders appear as in-app notifications under the bell icon.
Q: Will I be notified about waitlist offers? A: Yes, you get a notification when a waitlist slot is offered. You have 120 minutes to accept it.
Q: Where can I find my prescription? A: Open My Prescriptions in the app.
Q: When will my prescription appear? A: The doctor writes the prescription at the end of the consultation. It appears in My Prescriptions once the appointment is completed.
Q: What does a prescription contain? A: A prescription contains the date, the doctor, the diagnosis, each medicine with dosage, frequency, and duration, and the doctor's notes.
Q: Can one visit have more than one prescription? A: No, each appointment has one prescription.
Q: How do I get a refill? A: Book a follow-up appointment for a refill.
Q: There is an error on my prescription. What should I do? A: Please contact reception to report an error on a prescription.
Q: Can the AI assistant change my medicines? A: No, the assistant cannot change medicines. Only your doctor can change a prescription.
Q: I have side effects from my medicine. What should I do? A: Contact the clinic or your doctor about side effects. For emergencies call 999.
Q: When is my bill created? A: Reception creates the bill after your visit.
Q: How do I pay my bill? A: Pay at reception after the visit. Payment methods are cash, card, or mobile banking.
Q: Which payment methods do you accept? A: We accept cash, card, and mobile banking.
